name: Bitbucket Pipelines
description: Run a repository's custom pipelines, such as deploys, after a preview of what is live and what will run.

settings.label: Workspace
settings.description: The part after bitbucket.org/ in the repository URL.

settings.label: Atlassian account email
settings.description: For an Atlassian API token. Leave empty for a repository or workspace access token.

settings.label: API token
settings.description: Needs the read:repository, read:pipeline and write:pipeline scopes.

link.label: Create an Atlassian API token (choose “Create API token with scopes” → Bitbucket)

settings.label: Pipelines to offer
settings.description: Custom pipeline names, comma separated. Empty offers every custom pipeline.

settings.label: Health URLs
settings.description: Optional, one per line: pipeline = URL. The preview shows the build each environment serves (current-build-version header).

settings.label: Release number offset
settings.description: Added to the build number to show the release number, if your pipeline numbers releases that way.

actions.title: Run pipeline
actions.description: Run a custom pipeline, such as a staging or production deploy.
